LAW AND MOTION 302, PLAINTIFF JACQUELINE PIERI'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION. ARGUED AND THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING: ON THE ISSUE OF DUTY IS GRANTED IN PART AND DENIED IN PART. IT IS DENIED ON THE ISSUE OF A DUTY TO VACATE BECAUSE THERE ARE TRIABLE ISSUES OF FACT FOR PLAINTIFF'S MOTIVATION FOR INVOKING THE ELLIS ACT AND TRIABLE ISSUES OF FACT AS TO CERTAIN OF THE AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSES: 9TH BASED ON THE UNCERTAINTY AS TO WHY ROCK PLOICHCIK IS PERFORMING CERTAIN SERVICES; 10TH BASED ON THE SAME ISSUE AS THE 9TH; AND THE 11TH BASED ON PLAINTIFF'S MOTIVATION FOR INVOKING THE ELLIS ACT. THE MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION IS GRANTED AS TO THE FOLLOWING DEFENSES: 1ST, FAILURE TO COMPLY BASED ON THE CONTENTION THAT MS. PIERI IS NOT MS. PLICHCHCIK IS WITHOUT MERIT; 2ND, IMPROPER SERVICE IS WITHOUT MERIT; 5TH, RENT INCREASE NOT RELEVANT TO DUTY TO VACATE OR DAMAGES; 6TH, RETALIATORY RENT INCREASE NOT RELEVANT TO DUTY TO VACATE OR DAMAGES; 7TH AND 13TH, ESTOPPEL NOT RELEVANT TO THE DUTY TO VACATE OR DAMAGES; AND 8TH, WAIVER, NOT ACCEPTING RENT IS A CONDITION OF THE ELLIS ACT AND CANNOT CONSTITUTE WAIVER. PLAINTIFF SEEKS HOLD OVER DAMAGES FOR FAILURE TO VACATE, NOT RENT. THE FOLLOWING DEFENSES PRESENT TRIABLE ISSUES OF FACT ON THE ISSUE OF DAMAGES: 3RD, PAYMENT OF RELOCATION BENEFITS AND 4TH, HABITABILITY. MR. KRAUS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER. EVIDENTIARY OBJECTIONS STATED ON THE RECORD. JUDGE: PATRICK J. MAHONEY, REPORTER: MARIA TORREANO, CSR #8600
